messages:
Maya: @channel alert — seeing a spike of 429s across hosted API nodes, started ~09:12 UTC. Top hosts: api-host-3/7. Rate: ~8% 429s for the last 4m. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/alerts/ALERT-7592

Jordan: customers already pinging support, several workspaces showing partial failures (ws_41, ws_82). Escalating to eng.

Henry: looking at quota-service logs. I see a mass policy write at 09:10 from the console service: audit_id=aud-5521, actor=adele, target=global. Suspect a bad policy patch. Pulling audit now.

Adele: I shipped a change to the console yesterday that moves the "burst multiplier" control; the feature is marked dedicated-only but I accidentally left the rollout target to "all" for fast QA. The UI code sends an explicit field when unset: `{"burst":""}`. I didn't expect service to interpret empty string as zero. Rolling back the console flag now.

Liam: quota-service applyPatch code path converts patch values with `Number(patch.burst)` and treats `""` -> 0. So any missing/unset in UI becomes a hard 0 on the policy and causes immediate throttling. Code snippet: ```js
// QuotaWriteModel.applyPatch
if (patch.burst !== undefined) {
  policy.burst = Number(patch.burst)  // "" becomes 0
}
```

infra-bot: triggered rollback: console-service r-204 -> r-203 (deploy id r-204 -> r-203). Health checks passing on 4/4.

Henry: forcing cache invalidation for quota-service and scheduling a policy reload for affected tenants (~342 orgs). Also bumping global default burst to 500 temporarily to buy time while we backfill DB.

Maya: good. Adele please post the PR that fixes parsing and add a DB backfill to revert zeroed bursts. Also add a console-side validation to avoid sending empty strings.

Adele: PR: https://github.com/redwood/quota/pull/789 — fixes parsing to treat empty string as "unset", adds unit tests, and includes a backfill script to restore previous burst values from audit log. I'll queue the quota-service patch for canary.

Liam: canary deploy for quota-service patch scheduled, will monitor error budget. Also adding a safe-guard: service will now reject any patch where burst < 1 and log as malformed.

Henry: metrics: 429s reduced to 0.6% across hosts after rollback and cache reload. Error spikes back to baseline in ~7m.

Jordan: CS notified top-10 affected customers and offered proactive credits. Tracking follow-ups in support ticket #SUP-1122.

Maya: assigning postmortem owner to Adele. Please include timeline, RCA, test/validation gaps, and action items: UI validation, service-side validation, canary policy-change path, audit rule to flag global policy patches, and post-deploy alerting for quota changes.

Adele: ack. Will draft postmortem and include the backfill runbook and a follow-up RFC for safer policy patching UX. :thumbsup:

Maya: thanks everyone. Closing incident once postmortem posted and backfill completes.
